"Over the past 18 months, we have built a strong partnership with Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, centered on a shared commitment to innovation and helping customers modernize and automate their quality-control workflows,” said Robert Spignesi, President and CEO of Rapid Micro Biosystems. “Rapid Micro has established the Growth Direct platform as the leading solution for automating microbial quality control, with most of the world's top pharmaceutical manufacturers as customers.
